content.thinking: Our earlier transport test 'dictflag' expected capture by patching flag to1 and inserting zero before? It did `d[4]=(d[4]&~3)|1; d2=d[:5]+b'\0'+d[5:]`. Wait insert position wrong: after frame descriptor at index4, window descriptor at index5 should remain; dictionary ID comes after window descriptor, so should insert after index6, not after5. Their d2 inserted before window descriptor, so header became invalid maybe params error; got capture. Our new code test with valid zero dict should be accepted. Let's verify.

 print(name,p.stdout[:80])
